reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The `clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout` flag has been deprecated in favor of `clustermesh-sync-timeout`, and will be removed in Cilium 1.17", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: The `clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout` flag still works in Cilium 1.16 but is scheduled for removal in Cilium 1.17. Operators should migrate to the `clustermesh-sync-timeout` flag before upgrading to 1.17.

proposed.statement: The `clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout` CLI flag has been deprecated in favor of `clustermesh-sync-timeout` and will be removed in Cilium 1.17.
